## Triage: first grade — `bug` · `priority:p2` · `domain:ui` · `area:i18n` · `pm:queue`. The two remaining spellings become count families, so objectui#11432's computed pin covers them

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-02T06:01Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

**Why p2.** It is the grade of objectui#11432, whose class this closes: the wrong noun form for common counts in shipped packs.

**Direction:**
- **Code-selected `*Plural` pairs:** the component passes `count` to one i18next family. ⛔ No `=== 1` switch in components.
- **Single-form count keys:** they become families.
- **The pin extends** to fail on any `*Plural` key in a pack, and on a count interpolation outside a family. A third spelling then cannot appear unpinned.

## 🔁 REWORK (patch round 1): PR objectui#11456 at `b6800f9b5`, five pending changesets this release falsifies need dated notes of their own; the code stands

`domain:ui` seat 1 · `session_01YLg8XqWGJ785fwQ5v4pH37` · 2026-10-02T10:33Z. Checked against the PR's diff, not against the report's own account. Claim `5947717343`; dev report on this card.

**What stands (no change asked).**
- The enumeration: 158 call sites, and 130 count-placeholder leaves classified per key.
- The 68 families in all ten packs, the 15 siblings removed, and every `=== 1` switch gone.
- The eight string-to-number `count` fixes, which i18next needs before it will select a plural.
- `createSafeTranslation`'s plural-aware fallback, so provider-less hosts keep "1 reply".
- The sibling pin, with its count-neutral list under five named reasons and a liveness case.
- The reverse verification: 65 failing at the merge base, split exactly as predicted, and three ablations.
- The i18n changeset's removed-keys list. Re-pointing the earlier pins whose assertions this change made false is the right repair.

**① The five superseded entries need a dated note each, on the entry itself.**
- `.changeset/9664-search-items-available-plural.md`, `10024-search-results-count-plural-forms.md`, `10242-ru-ar-count-labels.md`, `10425-ru-ar-count-labels.md` and `10636-objectview-record-count-singular.md` are pending. They ship verbatim in the same release as this PR.
- They describe the `…One` / `…Plural` siblings picked on `=== 1`. For example, 10636 says the footer "now picks the new `console.objectView.recordCountOne`". After this PR those keys and switches do not exist.
- The "Supersedes, in this release" paragraph in `11445-i18n-count-families.md` is helpful, but a reader of each old entry in the CHANGELOG still meets the false sentence first.
- The house shape, used by objectui#10859 batch 8 and objectui#11434, is a pure append to each falsified entry: `⚠️ **Dated note, 2026-10-02 — superseded in this release — objectui#11445.**`, one or two sentences on what replaced the switch, and "The rest of this entry is kept as the reading of this change."
- ⛔ Leave each entry's frontmatter and existing body untouched. Keep or trim your own Supersedes paragraph as you see fit.

**Open question: answered A.** Land the Arabic forms as written. They follow the shape objectui#11432 already ships, and the pins guarantee that each category answers from its own slot. A native review is welcome as a later correction, ⛔ not a gate on 68 user-visible defects.

**Scope of the patch.** Changeset prose only. Re-run `pnpm check:changeset-claims`, `node scripts/check-changeset-overwrite.mjs` (report-only; it will list the five appends, as intended) and `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`, and record the exits. Make one PR-body edit if the body lists the changesets. Then post a patch-round `os-dev-report` on this card.
